description: [BETA] Get the detections of Sophos Fusion (Security Operations), with the Sophos Detections GraphQL API, for the tenants upgraded to Sophos Fusion. It replaces the deprecated 'Query IoC from data lake' connector. Beta: the format of the detections is not yet validated on every detection type.
name: [BETA] Get Sophos Fusion detections

chunk_size.description: The max size of chunks for the batch processing

min_severity.description: Only collect the detections with a severity greater than or equal to this value (from 0 to 1). Leave empty to collect all detections

intake_key.description: Intake key to use when sending events
